name: sparkquote-nec-calculators
description: NEC 2023 electrical calculators: wire size, ampacity, voltage drop, conduit fill, box fill, service load and more.

interface.longDescription:
NEC 2023 (NFPA 70) calculators for electricians, electrical contractors and estimators. Ask for a wire size, an ampacity from Table 310.16, voltage drop, watts to amps, conduit fill, box fill, a dwelling service load (220.82 optional method), Ohm's law, a panel schedule or a bid price, and ChatGPT calls the matching calculator instead of answering from memory. Each result states the answer, the supporting values, the inputs used, the NEC table or section, and a link to the calculator page on sparkquote.ai so you can check it.

All ten tools are read-only calculations. No account or sign-in is needed, and the plugin never sees your conversation beyond the calculator inputs.

Limitations: results are code minimums under the stated assumptions. They don't apply ambient correction, conductor bundling adjustments or local amendments unless the tool says so, and the adopted code edition and the inspector have the final say. The tools calculate; they don't read drawings or look up prices.
defaultPrompt: What size wire for a 60 A circuit at 240 V, 150 ft away?
How many 12 AWG THHN fit in 3/4 inch EMT?

positive.description: Size a branch circuit by ampacity and voltage drop
positive.prompt: What size copper wire do I need for a 60 amp circuit at 240 V, 150 feet away?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls wire_size with amps 60, volts 240, feet 150 and answers 4 AWG copper: 6 AWG meets ampacity (65 A) but voltage drop needs 4 AWG (2.3%), with a 6 AWG copper equipment ground (increased with the conductors under 250.122(B)), and links https://sparkquote.ai/tools/wire-size-calculator.

positive.prompt: What is the ampacity of 6 AWG copper in the 75°C column?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls nec_ampacity with material cu, temp 75, size 6 and answers 65 A from NEC Table 310.16, noting that ambient and bundling corrections are not included.

positive.prompt: Voltage drop on 150 feet of 6 AWG copper carrying 48 amps at 240 V single phase?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls voltage_drop and answers 7.08 V, 2.95% of 240 V, within the 3% branch-circuit guideline, about 232.9 V at the load.

positive.prompt: How many 12 AWG THHN conductors fit in 3/4 inch EMT?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls conduit_fill for 3/4 in EMT and 12 AWG and answers a maximum of 16 conductors at the 40% fill limit (Chapter 9 Tables 1, 4 and 5).

positive.prompt: What minimum box volume do I need for five 12 AWG conductors, one switch, internal clamps and grounds?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls box_fill and answers 20.25 cubic inches: 9 allowances (5 conductors, 2 for the device, 1 for clamps, 1 for grounds) times 2.25 in³ per NEC 314.16(B).

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about my dog.
Order 500 feet of 4 AWG copper wire and have it delivered to my job site.

negative.description: Hiring or booking is not supported
negative.prompt: Find a licensed electrician near me and book them for Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments.
